prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the passenger in a low-speed head-on collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1265; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is regarding the collision you were involved in on a street in Pasadena, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Can you tell me where you were sitting at the time of the collision?

A: I was in the front passenger seat of my friend's car. We were heading east on the main road when the other vehicle came into our lane.

Q: Was the other vehicle moving quickly?

A: Not really. It was more of a slow impact, maybe just a few miles per hour, but the cars were facing each other and it jolted us forward and then back. I put my arm out to brace myself against the dashboard.

Q: Did you hit anything with your body?

A: My wrist hit the dashboard and I felt a sharp pain right away. My hand swelled up pretty quickly after that.

Q: Did you go to a doctor or hospital after the collision?

A: Yes, we went to the emergency room that same evening. They took X-rays and told me the wrist was fractured. They put it in a splint and referred me to an orthopedic specialist.

Q: Have you been seeing the specialist since then?

A: Yes, I have a follow-up appointment next week. They said I may need a cast for several weeks and possibly therapy afterward.

Q: Did you have any prior injuries to that wrist?

A: No, not that I can recall. It had never given me trouble before.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just hope the other driver's insurance can help with the medical bills.

Q: Thank you. That concludes this recorded statement.
